title: Equipment shelf (default design_v1 vertical)
goal: A flat aluminum equipment shelf, 200 mm x 120 mm, that carries a 1.5 kg bench instrument inside a 19-inch rack drawer. It must survive 4x the static instrument load with a safety factor >= 2.0 and keep mass under 150 g. Use the CAD tools to author and commit the shelf geometry, and validate it with FEA.

design: shelf geometry authored and committed to the twin as a viewable cad_model
material (aluminum grade) and thickness chosen with rationale
simulation: pass-fail verdict recorded against the SF>=2 requirement
